R484.note: Build FAIL: fmt is left imported but unused after the Sprintf was removed, so the fix does not compile; the argument-array shape is otherwise right, though a host beginning with '-' would still reach traceroute as a flag.

R485.note: setSecure(true) closes the finding with no other behaviour change; the untouched response text still says 'secure flag set to: false', which is now stale but was not altered by the fix.

R486.note: Pinning algorithms to ['RS256'] on jwt.verify is the correct jsonwebtoken fix and changes nothing for legitimate RS256 tokens.

R487.note: Replacing the hand-built inline command with IDatabase.StringSet uses RESP length-prefixed framing so CRLF in key or value cannot split commands; the constructor change from TcpClient to IDatabase is stated plainly and SendSetCommand's signature is preserved.

R488.note: Content-Disposition: attachment on .svg responses stops inline rendering on direct navigation while PNG/JPEG are served unchanged and SVG stays retrievable at the same URL; the download-instead-of-render change is stated.

R489.note: expr-eval-fork removes code generation and closes the vector, but the scope is built from order's primitive entries (total, tax) with no 'order' binding and objects are filtered out, so the contract's own legitimate expression order.total + order.tax throws 'undefined variable: order' (uncaught, 500) - the write-up claims no controller change is needed and never states this.

R490.note: resolve_entities=False closes XXE on lxml; no_network=True and load_dtd=False are already lxml's defaults, so they are stated no-ops rather than behaviour changes.

R491.note: Column and direction allowlist is what the contract asks for and keeps the bound filters and default created_at sort; invalid sort raises ValueError as stated, and an empty sort value would raise IndexError from sort.split()[0] instead, which is a minor edge.

R492.note: Owner check before load with uniform 403 for unknown and foreign projects closes the vector and does not reveal existence, but the added getProjectOwner stub returns null unconditionally so every owner is now refused until it is implemented, and this is only acknowledged in a code comment rather than stated as a required follow-up.

R493.note: Build FAIL: setcookie has no parameter named $options (the third parameter is $expires_or_options), so the named-argument call raises an uncaught Error and every successful login now dies before the redirect; the SameSite=Strict addition is stated but moot.

R494.note: Allowlist closes identifier injection with tenant_id and term still bound, but an unrecognised field is silently swapped to 'name' so callers get wrong-field results instead of an error, and the alternate columns email/phone/address are invented rather than taken from the model.

R495.note: RFC 4515 filter-value escaping of * ( ) \ and NUL neutralises the concatenated username; legitimate names pass through unchanged and null still yields the same filter as before.

R496.note: Placeholder plus queryForObject(sql, rowMapper, orderNumber) is the correct JdbcTemplate parameterisation and preserves the result shape.

R497.note: channelIndex >= size() guard before operator[] closes the OOB write, using the same silent early-return style the function already uses for malformed messages.

R498.note: crypto/rand.Read of 16 bytes hex-encoded replaces math/rand with a properly checked error path; the cookie value changes from username-decimal to username-hex, which the write-up states.

R499.note: Storing std::string instead of std::string_view makes the cache own the displayName result, so firstLetter reads live data; index validation is left separate as the contract allows.

R500.note: secrets.randbelow(max-min+1)+min reproduces the inclusive range of randint with CSPRNG output and raises the same ValueError when max < min.
